findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed that both the gender-neutral customer bathrooms (located near the deli and the front service area) do not have covered trash cans. All toilet rooms used by females must have a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Ensure that bathrooms have covered trash cans by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.
